t: (3c257a23) devbox service liveness is inferred, never measured: (1) devbox_up short-circuits at .ci/lib/devbox.sh:493 when the container runs, so autostart (entrypoint-only) never re-dispatches and a dead service is unrevivable by ./run.sh setup; (2) devbox-autostart.sh start() gates on pgrep -f 'run.sh account dev', which matched a zombie shell whose gateway was dead -- the same dead-port trap .ci/lib/account.sh:141 documents; (3) devbox_up calls devbox_status immediately after docker start (devbox.sh:501-504), so a normally-starting Astro (>90s here) prints 'no backend yet'.

(3c257a23) TRAPS candidate: a single-FILE docker bind mount pins the INODE, so editing .devcontainer/devbox-autostart.sh on the host leaves a running container serving the pre-edit bytes forever (measured 2026-09-09: host inode 4874047 vs container 3155898). A test of such an edit silently tests the OLD code -- the exact shape TRAPS.md exists for. Fixed for autostart by dispatching the workspace-directory copy instead; devbox-entrypoint.sh is mounted the same way and is still exposed.

(3c257a23) devbox-autostart start() guard was dead code for account-db: run.sh account db EXECS into sqlite_web (.ci/lib/account.sh:1110), so pgrep -f 'run.sh account db' never matched and a second sqlite_web was started on every dispatch (observed live: pid 29 on :17263 plus a duplicate on :17264). Cured by the port-based test, but only because the host now passes DEVBOX_DB_PORT through docker exec.
